name: Sok Pisey
text: Training under Mr. Ny Rithy transformed my career. I went from a beginner to competing in Kun Khmer within 18 months. His deep knowledge of Bokator and modern conditioning is unmatched in Cambodia.

textBy.en: Training under Mr. Ny Rithy transformed my career. I went from a beginner to competing in Kun Khmer within 18 months. His deep knowledge of Bokator and modern conditioning is unmatched in Cambodia.
textBy.km: ការបង្វឹកក្រោមលោក ញ៉ី រិទ្ធី បានផ្លាស់ប្តូរអាជីពរបស់ខ្ញុំ។ ខ្ញុំពីអ្នកចាប់ផ្តើមក្លាយជាអ្នកប្រកួតគុនខ្មែរក្នុងរយៈពេល ១៨ ខែ។
textBy.zh: 在 Ny Rithy 先生指导下训练改变了我的职业生涯。我在18个月内从初学者成长为参加高棉拳比赛的选手。

name: Chen Dara
text: I lost 25kg and gained real strength. The martial arts conditioning program is intense but perfectly structured. Mr. Rithy pushes you beyond your limits while keeping you safe.

textBy.en: I lost 25kg and gained real strength. The martial arts conditioning program is intense but perfectly structured. Mr. Rithy pushes you beyond your limits while keeping you safe.
textBy.km: ខ្ញុំបានធ្លាក់ទម្ងន់ ២៥ គីឡូក្រាម និងទទួលបានកម្លាំងពិតប្រាកដ។ កម្មវិធីការពង្រឹងកីឡាចំបុយប្រយុទ្ធាមានភាពតានតឹងប៉ុន្តែត្រូវបានរចនាឡើងយ៉ាងល្អ។
textBy.zh: 我减重25公斤并获得了真正的力量。武术体能训练强度大但结构完美。

name: Kim Sophea
text: As a busy executive, I needed efficient training. The private sessions with Mr. Rithy fit my schedule and delivered results fast. My energy levels and mental clarity have never been better.

textBy.en: As a busy executive, I needed efficient training. The private sessions with Mr. Rithy fit my schedule and delivered results fast. My energy levels and mental clarity have never been better.
textBy.km: ក្នុងនាមជានាយកប្រតិបត្តិដែលមានភាពរវល់រវល់ ខ្ញុំត្រូវការការបង្វឹកដែលមានប្រសិទ្ធភាព។ ពេលវេលាបង្វឹកផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនជាមួយលោក រិទ្ធី សមនឹងកាលកំណត់របស់ខ្ញុំ។
textBy.zh: 作为忙碌的高管，我需要高效训练。私人课程完美契合我的时间表并快速见效。

name: Vath Navy
text: I joined to learn self-defense and discovered a whole culture. Learning Bokator connected me to my Khmer heritage in a way I never expected. Mr. Rithy is not just a coach, he's a cultural guardian.

textBy.en: I joined to learn self-defense and discovered a whole culture. Learning Bokator connected me to my Khmer heritage in a way I never expected. Mr. Rithy is not just a coach, he's a cultural guardian.
textBy.km: ខ្ញុំបានចូលរួមដើម្បីរៀនការការពារខ្លួនឯង ហើយបានរកឃើញវប្បធម៌ទាំងមូល។ ការរៀនបុកាទ័របានភ្ជាប់ខ្ញុំទៅនឹងបេតិកាខ្មែរ។
textBy.zh: 我加入是为了学习自卫，却发现了整个文化。学习斗狮拳让我与高棉传承产生了意想不到的联系。

name: Tan Rasmey
text: The Yuthakram Khom training opened my eyes to the depth of Cambodian martial arts. The weapon forms, the grappling, the philosophy — it's a complete system. Best training experience of my life.

textBy.en: The Yuthakram Khom training opened my eyes to the depth of Cambodian martial arts. The weapon forms, the grappling, the philosophy — it's a complete system. Best training experience of my life.
textBy.km: ការបង្វឹកយុទ្ធក្រមខ្មែរបានបើកភ្នែកខ្ញុំទៅនឹងជម្រៅនៃសិល្បៈកីឡាចំបុយប្រយុទ្ធខ្មែរ។ វាគឺជាប្រព័ន្ធពេញលេញ។
textBy.zh: 高棉武技训练让我看到了柬埔寨武术的深度。武器形态、缠斗、哲学——这是一个完整的体系。
